note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: IterCOMP: pilot findings drive an iterative, reasoning-aware compression design with measured gains

nodes.name: Long retrieved inputs hurt RAG
nodes.description: Long retrieved contexts increase latency and cost linearly with document count and include irrelevant content that distracts LLMs and triggers positional biases like lost-in-the-middle.

nodes.name: Single-query compression fails multi-hop
nodes.description: Query-focused compression matching one query to individual documents or sentences cannot capture inter-document dependencies and implicit intermediate clues in multi-hop QA, causing information loss.

nodes.name: LLMs judge answerability
nodes.description: On MuSiQue sub-QA data, LLMs can judge whether evidence suffices; F1 is 70.51 (Llama-3.1-8B), 84.27 (Mistral-7B), 73.12 (GPT-3.5-Turbo) and 83.57 (GPT-4o).

nodes.name: Full-evidence accuracy falls with hops
nodes.description: In the Full-evidence setting answerability accuracy declines as hops increase (Mistral-7B 92% at 2-hop to 78.5% at 4-hop), while under Partial evidence it improves with hop length.

nodes.name: LLMs can name missing information
nodes.description: LLMs generate related follow-up questions for missing information (GPT-4o relatedness 90.6%, BLEU 0.50), but quality declines with hop count.

nodes.name: Iteration budget is bounded
nodes.description: Because misjudging unanswerable as answerable stops early and the reverse causes noisy extra iterations, with Full-setting accuracy degrading, IterCOMP uses answerability as a stopping signal with a bounded iteration cap (max 5).

nodes.name: Iterative compression loop
nodes.description: IterCOMP splits documents into sentence-level evidence segments, filters relevant ones, has an LLM judge answerability, and if insufficient generates a targeted follow-up question to pull in new evidence, accumulating a compact reasoning-oriented prompt.

nodes.name: Dual relevance with percentile filtering
nodes.description: Relevance combines bge-m3 semantic similarity and lexical weighted-overlap similarity (lambda=0.6), and segments above the k-th score percentile are kept (k=90 for MuSiQue/HotpotQA, 85 for 2Wiki), applied at every reasoning step.

nodes.name: Best QA with large compression
nodes.description: Training-free IterCOMP achieves the best EM and F1 on MuSiQue, 2Wiki and HotpotQA with a LLaMA-3-8B reader, e.g. MuSiQue F1 19.92 -> 27.36 (7x shorter input) and HotpotQA 43.63 -> 51.78 over raw documents.

nodes.name: Adapts to question complexity
nodes.description: On MuSiQue the average iterations rise to 3.08 for 4-hop questions and compressed prompt length grows from 228 to 403 tokens from 2-hop to 4-hop, so depth and evidence size adapt to complexity.

nodes.name: Iterative refinement matters most
nodes.description: In ablations removing Iterative Refinement causes the largest drop, removing Answerability Judgment cuts F1 to 23.63 and gives less compact prompts, and combining semantic and lexical similarity beats either alone.

nodes.name: Percentile k tradeoff
nodes.description: On MuSiQue F1 rises with k to a peak of 27.36 at k=90 then drops at k=95 because too strict a cutoff discards needed evidence; at k>=90 prompts are shorter than Oracle's.

nodes.name: Cost savings on API LLMs
nodes.description: On 500 MuSiQue instances, compression cuts reader-LLM cost by 75.5%-79.4% and speeds up inference across API models.

isolated_nodes.name: Stated limitations
isolated_nodes.description: IterCOMP depends on the reasoning ability of the underlying LLM (risking error propagation), incurs iterative overhead versus single-pass methods, is sensitive to percentile and iteration-limit hyperparameters, and was evaluated only on general-domain multi-hop QA.

isolated_nodes.name: Soft prompts do not transfer
isolated_nodes.description: Soft-prompt compression methods are optimized for specific LLMs, limiting transferability and requiring retraining on model updates, which is impractical for API-based settings.

structural_reasoning: Pilot studies of LLM answerability and gap identification justify the iterative answerability-gated loop; its retrieval filtering and loop design underlie benchmark gains, adaptivity, ablations and cost savings.
